completed: Final owner: 9 zlib, 8 header-stripping and 6 text tests passed.
Final native playback/export, identity copy, packet limits and audio timeline checks passed.
Root WebM unit suite: 36 passed on final scope-default source.
11 paired accepted synthetic cases include dynamic/fixed/stored DEFLATE, empty/default scope, implicit algorithm, lacing, late tracks, Opus and constant-resolution export.
qualification: Eleven paired synthetic cases restore original codec bytes and clocks: dynamic/fixed/stored DEFLATE, implicit algorithm/encoding, empty scope default, lacing, late tracks, Opus and constant-resolution export.

Native software VP9 playback matches control pixels, dimensions, timestamps, seek, rewind and EOF. Constant-resolution video transcodes to FFV1 with exact pixels and intervals; identity copies retain every encoded byte. Variable-resolution playback is qualified independently of the constant-resolution transcode case.
Opus TOCs and PCM match the uncompressed control exactly. Cancellation emits no PCM. Controlled audio admission includes fixed inflater state and compressed-input scratch.
Checksum failures, truncation, invalid headers, trailing stream data, empty decoded frames and decoded-output limit violations have separate refusal assertions before codec decoding.
Encoded and decoded lengths are independently bounded. Known restored-size admission precedes packet I/O and caller-buffer mutation; initial indexing uses the configured packet limit.

Scope is one frame-only zlib or header-stripping transform. Codec-private transforms, chains, nonempty zlib settings, bzip2/lzo and encryption remain explicitly unsupported. The former unsupported-zlib fixture now has enabled successful acceptance checks; a valid bzip2 fixture remains a declared refusal.
Software runtime qualification only; player configuration checks successfully. No hardware runtime or speed claim.
counting: One useful container compatibility capability. All DEFLATE/default/lace/audio variants, damaged-input refusals, resource accounting and supporting API additions count together.
